messages:
Elaine: Quick proposal — we need a more forgiving way to negotiate MVP vs v1 without constantly re-scoping mid-sprint. My idea: a "milestone ladder" with 3 checkpoints (launch, post-launch, v1) and clear gating criteria for what moves between them. Will sketch below.
Sam: thanks. can you call out which customer asks are blocking launch vs which are nice-to-have? customers are already asking for embeddings and SSO.
Elaine: sure — here's a rough mapping we can iterate on:
```
MILESTONE 1 (Launch - MVP): core text gen API, basic auth, single-tenant defaults, prompt templates
MILESTONE 2 (Post-launch weeks 0-6): embeddings pilot (opt-in), telemetry dashboard (skeleton), caching tweaks
MILESTONE 3 (v1 - 6-12w): SSO, multi-tenant routing, reserved/dedicated infra, expanded QA/regressions
Gating: no critical regressions in top 5 prompts, <200ms P50 for core API, admin+audit for v1 features
```
Vik: engineer perspective: SSO + multi-tenant routing are a bundled 4-6 week effort. If we move SSO to v1 we free up ~3 weeks for launch work. embeddings pilot can be a soft launch feature behind a flag. :+1:
Lina: design: we can ship core flows with skeleton telemetry (page with counters + links to logs). full analytics can be v1. need to align copy for feature flags though.
Jamal: infra notes: dedicated infra (reserved capacity) needs capacity commitments and infra automation (2-3w). we should not promise Dedicated for launch unless we shift capacity from other pilots. also watch for bursting costs.
Sam: suggested prioritization rule: if a customer legal/security or sales-blocking ask -> escalate to v1 gating review; otherwise prefer to move to Post-launch. That should keep MVP small.
Elaine: proposal for decision: today by EOD — commit to milestone ladder and move SSO + multi-tenant to v1; keep embeddings in Post-launch as opt-in. everyone react with :thumbsup: to agree or reply with constraints.
Vik: :thumbsup: but callout — moving SSO to v1 means we need to hardline feature-flagging for pilot tenants (I'll add a checklist).
Lina: :thumbsup:
Jamal: :thumbsup: pending capacity approval from infra finance (I opened a ticket).
Sam: I'll update roadmap and the release checklist after we close. I want a short roll-forward plan if Post-launch slips — propose a single-mechanism fallback: revert to single-tenant and rate-limit heavy routing.
product-ops-bot: Decision doc created: https://company.docs/repo/milestone-ladder/1910202020 — added labels: "mvp-decision", "milestone-ladder".
Elaine: thanks — I'll consolidate notes and ping stakeholders for any follow-ups. If anyone has blockers, drop them here before 5pm today.
